name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 15, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Mayor Blakespear and Council Member Hinze regarding the status of the Encinitas Equity Committee
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Sanderson
Staff recommends that the City Council review and approve the warrants
2021-12-15 Item 08A Approval of Warrants List
8B.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the 2022 calendar year City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the 2002 calendar year City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2021-112 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Approving Changes to the Calendar Year 2022 City Council Meeting Schedule” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08B 2022 Council Meeting Schedule
8C.
Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2023. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Karen Koblentz to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy with a term ending March 2023.
2021-12-15 Item 08C Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission
8D.
Environmental Commission Recommendation Actions to Support the Safe Decommissioning of the San Onofre Nuclear Generation Station (SONGS). Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
1) Adopt Resolution 2021-119 titled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas to Support the Safe Decommissioning of the San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station (SONGS) (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08D SONGS Resolution
2021-12-15 Item 08D SONGS Resolution - Public Comments Received by 3PM 121521
8E.
Extensions of Memorandum of Agreement with the County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency and the Memorandum of Understanding with the Community Resource Center for the Temporary Emergency Motel Voucher Program for the COVID-19 response for emergency non-congregate sheltering to extend the program through March 31, 2022. Contact Person: Housing Services Manager Gutierrez
1) Authorize the City Manager to execute, in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, an amendment to the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and the County of San Diego signed by the City Manager/Director of Emergency Services to provide hotel rooms for “high-risk” individuals that are experiencing homelessness during the COVID-19 pandemic to extend the term through March 31, 2022 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Subject to approval of the above-referenced County MOA, authorize the City Manager to execute, in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, the amendment to the existing Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Community Resource Center (CRC) to provide case management services for the current “high-risk” individuals utilizing temporary lodging to extend the term through March 31, 2022 (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08E Motel Voucher Extension
2021-12-15 Item 08E Motel Voucher Extension - Public Comments Received by 3PM 121521
8F.
Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2020-21. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
1) Receive the report on ending fund balances for FY 2020-21; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution 2021-106, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget” to authorize an additional discretionary payment to CalPERS in the amount of $500,000 to reduce the City of Encinitas unfunded pension liability.
2021-12-15 Item 08F Report on the Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2020-21
8G.
Amendment to the San Diego Community Power Joint Powers Agreement between the Founding Member Cities of San Diego, Chula Vista, La Mesa, Imperial Beach, and Encinitas, and anticipate new Member Agencies, the County of San Diego and National City. Contact Person: Sustainability Manager Najera
1) Acknowledge the proposed amendments to the San Diego Community Power Joint Powers Agreement (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Delegate to the City Manager, or her designee, the authority to provide comments to the amendments if needed.
2021-12-15 Item 08G SDCP JPA Amendment
8H.
Cooperation and Administrative Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and San Diego Community Power. Contact Person: Human Resources Analyst Chase
Authorize the City Manager to execute the renewed Cooperation and Administrative Agreement by and between San Diego Community Power and the City of Encinitas through June 30, 2022, for human resources and other services.
2021-12-15 Item 08H SDCP Human Resources Agreement
8I.
Authorization to purchase and add new vehicles to the City’s Fleet Inventory in Fiscal Year 2021-22. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Approve the addition of a new Marine Safety Vehicle and Fire Prevention Vehicle to the City’s Fleet Inventory; and 2) Authorize the purchase of two vehicles, including outfitting, for an amount not to exceed $130,900 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08I New Vehicles for Fleet Inventory FY22
8J.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Friends of the Arts (EFA). Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Murphy
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding with Encinitas Friends of the Arts, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, to elevate arts and culture in the community through quality programs, fundraising, marketing, and advocacy through December 31, 2023 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08J MOU between City of Encinitas and Encinitas Friends of the Arts
8K.
Approve Design, Award Construction Contract and Approve Budget Adjustments for the Trail 95 Project (CP00F). Contact Person: Engineer II Kirk
1) Approve the design plans (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) for the Trail 95 project; 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-122 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Design for Construction of the Trail 95 Project, Pursuant to Government Code Section 830.6” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 3 of the agenda report and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Tri-Group Construction & Development, Inc. in the amount of $521,459. Future contract amendments of up to $104,292 (20 percent contingency) are hereby authorized for a contract not-to-exceed amount of $625,751; and 4) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2021-121 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Adopted Budget” to increase the Trail 95 Project budget by $54,535 (Attachment 4 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08K Trail 95 Award of Construction Contract
8L.
Appointment of an Authorized Representative from the City of Encinitas to execute Master and Supplemental Agreements with the State of California Department of Transportation for grant-funded projects. Contact Person: Acting City Engineer Bankston
Adopt City Council Resolution 2021-111 entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Approving the Appointment of an Authorized Representative," appointing the Director of Infrastructure and Sustainability, or her designee, as the authorized representative for the City of Encinitas to execute Master and Supplemental Agreements with the State of California Department of Transportation for grant-funded projects (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08L CA DOT Master Agreement - Grant Funded Projects
8M.
Opioid settlement agreements with McKesson Corporation, Cardinal Health, Inc., AmerisourceBergen Corporation, Johnson & Johnson, Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Ortho- McNeil-Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Janssen Pharmaceutical Inc. Contact Person: Administrative Services Director Schwarm
Adopt Resolution No. 2021-125 entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Authorizing the City of Encinitas to enter into the Settlement Agreements with McKesson Corporation, Cardinal Health, Inc., AmerisourceBergen Corporation, Johnson & Johnson, Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Ortho-McNeil-Janssen Pharmaceuticals, Inc., and Janssen Pharmaceutical Inc., Agreeing to the Terms of the MOU Allocating Settlement Proceeds, and Authorizing Entry into the MOU with the Attorney General”.
2021-12-15 Item 08M Opioid Settlements
8N.
Approval of funding for two (2) Habitat for Humanity homes on Leucadia Blvd. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates
1) Authorize providing up to $235,000 to Habitat for Humanity for construction of two affordable homes off Leucadia Blvd; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-124 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget,” approving the transfer of $235,000 from the Affordable Housing Acquisition CIP budget for two affordable homes (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08N Habitat for Humanity Loan
8O.
Part-time, Reserve, Seasonal, Temporary Employee Salary Schedule Adjustment for Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts and Marine Safety. Contact Person: Human Resources Analyst Chase
1) Adopt Resolution 2021-123 entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Adopting Part-Time, Reserve, Seasonal, Temporary Employee Salary Schedule Adjustment” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) and extended limited benefits provide to three critical part-time employee positions in the Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department. Adjustments are to be effective January 7, 2022; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2021-126 entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2021-22 Budget” appropriating funds for additional staffing expenditures (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 08O Part-Time Temporary Seasonal Salary Schedule
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Presentation of the City’s Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2021. Contact Person: Finance Manager Attili
Accept and file the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2021.
2021-12-15 Item 10A FY 2020-21 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
10B.
City Council discussion regarding the COVID-19 pandemic Executive Order related to temporary outdoor dining. Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
Discuss the expiration of the State of California COVID-19 Executive Order and provide direction to staff on interim and long-term solutions related to temporary outdoor dining as necessary.
2021-12-15 Item 10B Outdoor Dining
2021-12-15 Item 10B Outdoor Dining - Public Comments Received by 3PM 121521
10C.
City Council to consider adoption of an Urgency Ordinance pertaining to development regulations for urban lot splits and two-unit residential development in single family zones as allowed under Senate Bill 9 (“SB 9”) and initiate amendments to the General Plan, Local Coastal Plan, Encinitas Municipal Code and Specific Plans. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates
1) Adopt Ordinance No. 2021-25 titled “An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Pertaining to Development Regulations for Urban Lot Splits and Two-Unit Residential Development in Single Family Zones to Implement Senate Bill 9” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-120 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Initiating Amendments to the General Plan, Municipal Code, Specific Plans and Local Coastal Program Pertaining to Development Regulations for Urban Lot Splits and Two-Unit Residential Development in Single Family Zones to Implement Senate Bill 9” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report).
2021-12-15 Item 10C SB9 Urgency Ordinance
2021-12-15 Item 10C SB9 Urgency Ordinance - Public Comments Received by 3PM 121521
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Streetscape and El Portal Status Update. Contact Person: Acting City Engineer Bankston
Receive the oral presentation.
2021-12-15 Item 11A Streetscape and El Portal Status Update - Staff Presentation
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 19, 2022
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
